eyebrow: Saving a script under a name
code:
CREATE PROCEDURE usp_GetExpensiveProducts
AS
BEGIN
    SELECT Name, ListPrice
    FROM Production.Product
    WHERE ListPrice > 1000
    ORDER BY ListPrice DESC;
END
caption: A view saves ONE SELECT — a procedure saves an entire script.
The whole body runs as one reusable, single-line call.

eyebrow: Anything goes inside — that's the point
caption: Variables, IF/ELSE, anything from this chapter — bundled under one name.
